items.title: GitHub - affaan-m/agentshield: AI agent security scanner. Detect vulnerabilities in agent configurations, MCP servers, and tool permissions. Available as CLI, GitHub Action, ECC plugin, and GitHub App integration. 🛡️
items.snippet: Supply-chain verification (agentshield scan --supply-chain) extracts MCP package references plus root package.json and package-lock.json dependency evidence, then reports provenance counts for npm vs git, pinned vs unpinned, known-good packages, and npm-registry-backed metadata.
